reason: ₱1,800 is more than what I pay for gel art at my salon in SM Masinag, and I already get my nails done while I'm at the mall anyway, so home service doesn't save me anything. For the wedding I'd just book my usual salon a day before.
objection: Why pay more to have a stranger in my house when I like the salon and get it done while shopping? I don't know this artist's work yet, and I'd want to be sure the ₱1,800 isn't just for simple designs.
would_change_my_mind: A first-booking promo near ₱1,200 for the wedding, with a real portfolio and reviews from Cainta clients on their Facebook page.
